steps.text: Erasing memories. This is something Theresa actually lacks experience in.
Not to mention she now faces a rare kind of mind.
She knows not what she will see, and has no clue if it will be dangerous. But there is no room to retreat.
She has made the final decision of her life.
She walks into the Doctor's memories, and cuts them up into countless fragments of dissipating threads.
Memory fades away in silence.
She walks through a world she has never seen and could never understand.
How did such a glorious civilization meet its end?
How do geniuses as bright as shooting stars struggle for a solution to their ultimate problem, yet find nothing?
Is resistance futile? Is unity a mere fantasy?
Is Terra's future already set in stone? What of her beloved homeland?
What of her loved ones?
She has no answer. She cannot find the answer.
She can only continue meandering in the void of memories gone.
Finally, she sees someone familiar.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Is all their enthusiasm overwhelming you?

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: What brings you here, Kal'tsit?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Should I not be present at this celebration of your latest victory?

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: It's been a long time since I last... days like these were rare back then, you know.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Or I should say, I've grown so unaccustomed to it now.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No matter, you will get used to it again, in time. Babel will be a new beginning.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Go. We should enjoy this celebration.
Theresa watches Kal'tsit pat the Doctor before gently pushing that very back into the waiting crowd.
Too many are forcing their way through the throng, hands stretched out, fighting each other to be the first to shake the Doctor's hand, or pat the Doctor's shoulder.
Some taller and gutsier ones even try to put their hands right on the Doctor's head for a good kneading.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Uh, sorry about that unruly subordinate of mine, Doctor. I wanted to stop him...

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: But my arm's injured... so I couldn't make it in time.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: It's fine... how's your arm?

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Recovery's going pretty well.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: It's a pity you won't get to enjoy many drinks here tonight.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: That's alright, Doctor. I'll have a few more pints on this guy's behalf.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: We might have gotten ourselves stuck in that encirclement, had you not sprung that surprise attack at the end.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: C'mon, let's slam a few glasses to honor the Doctor!

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: I'm afraid my alcohol tolerance may disappoint you, Ace.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Excuuuuse—me,—make—way please... I have to see the protagonist of the day!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: So many people in here! This is the first time I feel that the command center is too small... do you want me to widen it later? There's still so many people outside hurrying in here with snacks and drinks.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Doctor, everyone's cheering for the victory you've brought us, but you seem a little... uneasy.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: I thought I was masking it pretty well. *ahem* I'm just a little nervous in crowds.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Hey, careful. That's enough pushing. Amiya, you good?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm okay!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor! Come with me, Theresa and I made you a cake!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Look, the oven was so hot I got a blister on my finger.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Thank you... Oh! Are you okay? Does anyone have some burn cream...?
A gentle cough sounds in the room, and the crowd splits into two.
Theresa sees a woman dressed in white passing by, smiling as she extends a hand to the Doctor with a still healing needle wound.
She is looking at herself.
The joy fades away, as do the memories and voices.
Theresa erases the memory she is too familiar with, and continues forward.
She sees a record she has never seen before within PRTS.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Invoke imaging capabilities. Enable administrator-level encryption.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Image number (0091_admin)...... Add subject: (This is for you).

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Activating recorder... Beginning video record.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: If I didn't hold on until you woke up, you'll see this video.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: I will remain here, in the safest of places until everything settles.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Once I'm done with everything, I'll vanish into silence...

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Disappearing before all those who hate me.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: There is always a voice inside me, reminding me, asking me—'Who am I?'

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Our own watcher? Or a traitor to future civilizations?

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: I can no longer recognize myself—

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: You'll get an answer after checking all the logs I left behind. But for now at least, I'll no longer hesitate to do what I should do.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: When you wake up, I will have already disappeared in your past, and also unable to appear in our promised future.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: That's why I hope...

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: ...Pause recording. Delete all previous content. I... still need a bit more time.
She does not pause or sigh, just continues what she ought to do in silence.
Theresa goes deeper into the buried memories.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: I need you to contact the closest rescue team! The wrecked transport has a Rim Billiton logo on it, this is your squad...

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: I hear someone still alive in there!

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: *bzzt* We got your call, but it'll take some time for us to rush over from the nearest mining plate.

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: Based on the information you gave us, there's been banditry at your location there before, so we'll also notify armed security to send a dispatch at once.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: ...Armed security...? But with the way Rim Billiton treats Infected orphans...

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Hmph—

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Just hold on... I'll get you out of there myself...

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Please, stay with me... gah... that's a good girl, give me your hand.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Hold tight!
But... I'm so... tired...

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: What's your name—
Name...?
Mum... calls me... Amiya...

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Amiya, just hold on tight!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I... I'm holding—

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: I won't let go—
The memory shatters.
This is Theresa's destination, the terminus of the Doctor's memory—
'Theresa...'

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: This is impossible. Every memory should have been...
'Theresa.'
She follows the voice to a void, and it speaks once more from behind the nothingness.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Where am I—
You're finally here. I've been waiting for you.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Doctor...?
Doctor?
Not many people call me that. They prefer my team codename—'Oracle'.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: ...Oracle...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: So you're the one Kal'tsit believes in.

steps.name: Oracle
steps.text: I've let her down terribly. But we had no choice, I'm entangled in an inescapable plot.

steps.name: Oracle
steps.text: I've been watching you from here as you went around nurturing your hopes, as you suffered betrayal—

steps.name: Oracle
steps.text: As if I was looking at my past self.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: ...I'm sorry.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: You are only residue of the Doctor's burned away emotions. There's no way for me to preserve your emotions and memories in our current circumstances...

steps.name: Oracle
steps.text: You've reached your destination, so just do what you have to do.

steps.name: Oracle
steps.text: Thank you for trusting me.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: It may be a little late for this... but I'm glad to meet you.

steps.name: Oracle
steps.text: I'm glad to meet you too, Theresa.
Oracle walks into the distance of the endless wheat fields, disappearing within the stalks.
A draft of wind tears through the plain with a roar, and the final scene disperses until only the end of a thread is left.
Theresa holds the strand. It quickly loses its luster, and turns into powdery dust.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: It's time to say goodbye...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: We'll meet again in the future, won't we...?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Kal'tsit... Amiya...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: ......{@nickname}.
Theresa lets go of the final strand of thread in her hand, and watches it disperse and fade away like starlight.
She takes a step forward, towards hope...
Towards death.
